card.name: The word more after much
card.fires_on: The word "more" right after "much", as in "much more". It appears in general web text, both mid-sentence and at the end of a list.

modes.label: Comparison with much
modes.description: "much more" used as a comparison, often followed by "than" or an adjective or noun.
modes.example: It starts with the most basic information and progresses to much<< more>> technical information.

modes.label: List-ending and much more
modes.description: "and much more" closing a list of features or offerings.
modes.example: informative telescope reviews, and much<< more>>!
